definitions: Cultivated plants, especially cereals, fruit, or vegetables, grown on a large scale as food or for other economic purposes.
A group or collection of things appearing at the same time.
The produce of a cultivated plant.
A pouch in the gullet of a bird or insect in which food is stored for digestion or for regurgitation to young.
examples: The main crops grown are wheat and barley.
She had her hair cut in a short crop.
A new crop of students arrived.
The farmer harvested a good crop.
The bird's crop was full of seeds.
